name: Webb Lake Campground, Fred C. Babcock/Cecil M. Webb Wildlife Management Area
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Webb Lake Road, Babcock/Webb Wildlife Management Area, Punta Gorda, FL
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Two loops of primitive sites in pine flatwoods beside Webb Lake, with vault toilets and nothing else; bring water and firewood. It is the nearest near-free site found to the North Port stop on the drive up from Miami. Camping runs during the hunting seasons and on weekends (5 p.m. Friday to 9 p.m. Sunday) the rest of the year, and Nov 21, 2026 is a Saturday.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: Not stated; equipment may not be left unattended more than five consecutive days The 2026-27 hunt dates for this area were not obtained (the agency's brochure tool returned an error). A reservation plus dated permit is required during general gun season; a dated permit covers archery, small game, and weekends and holidays outside hunting season. Statewide Zone A general gun on private land runs Nov 21, 2026 - Jan 3, 2027, but wildlife-area dates are set separately. Wear orange on hunt days. Each camper also needs a daily-use permit ($3 per person or $6 per vehicle) or a management area permit.

conditions.summary: Camping is allowed on weekends year-round and during hunting seasons, so Saturday Nov 21 should qualify either way, but the 2026-27 season calendar and whether a general-gun reservation is needed that night were not confirmed. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
